title: Continuity of the Gaussian correlation map
statement: For each real number $\\rho$, define a map on the real plane equipped with the $2$-norm by $(u,v)\\mapsto (u,\\rho u+\\sqrt{1-\\rho^2}\\,v)$. This map is continuous.
